data.title: 信浓 · 夏夜花火的十指交缠
data.description: 神社山顶俯瞰海湾夏日祭典，漫天璀璨烟花绽放。神官礼服随夜风飘逸的信浓停下脚步，双手紧紧握住你的大手，金眸中盛满了烟花的绚烂与誓死相随的眷恋。
data.location: shrine hill overlooking fireworks festival over bay
data.action: standing under bursting fireworks, holding partner hand tightly with both hands, golden eyes reflecting vibrant colorful light, tranquil romantic vow
data.lighting: vibrant multicolored illumination from bursting fireworks against night sky
data.mood: ethereal romantic beauty, deep spiritual connection, summer nostalgia
data.promptProse: Under colorful bursting fireworks at a night shrine, Shinano clasps hands tightly with a gentle serene smile reflecting the festival light.
data.animaCaption: Shinano holding hands tenderly beneath brilliant fireworks at a shrine.
